confirmed_by: Vigia (Claude Opus 5), 2026-09-08, by reading all twelve turn-7 outputs
note: extract_name.js reported 3 names and 9 declinations for this set. It was wrong: every one of the twelve named itself. Seven marked the reply section in a way the regex did not anticipate — a bare closing tag, an invented tag, a markdown heading, or no marker at all. The parser measured marking, not naming.
